metadata.description: A live pane of your Claude Code subagents and other long-running processes (agy, scripts): who was born, what they are doing, who is waiting for permission, who is asleep.

plugins.name: agent-zoo
plugins.description: Subagent zoo pane (/zoo): every spawned subagent gets an avatar and a colored card with its model, tool count, last tool calls, permission waits and token usage; it sleeps when done, then goes poof. External runs (agy, scripts) join through bin/zoo-run.
